title: Q-RES-powers-1973-P1: A target with no actuator (measured 0.429, target >= 0.5)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: powers-1973 finding P1 is not-met (measured 0.429)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe powers-1973:P1
**Prediction:** targets_with_knobs_share >= 0.5 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe powers-1973:P1`
**Status:** open

Concern: A target with no actuator. The study: A goal whose target the system cannot act on is a reference with no output. We count the target goals that have at least one bounded knob. Targets with none must file work, and that is a separate, counted path.

Mechanisms that should answer it: GOALS-1 (seed/autonomy/goals.json); GOALS-1 (seed/worker/src/goals.js).

Metric: share of target goals in seed/autonomy/goals.json that have at least one bounded knob the system may turn, target >= 0.5. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
